LanguageData.SEC_Title_Alfau_Resident.label: Alfau Resident
LanguageData.SEC_Title_Alfau_Resident.description: Alfau residents refer to intelligent beings who have obtained right of residence in Alfau but do not have Alfau citizenship. They don't need to fulfill their civic obligations and cannot enjoy civil rights, they can settle, work and be served by secretaries on the territory of the People's State of Alfau, of course, they also need to comply with Alfau's laws and obey secretaries' management.
LanguageData.SEC_Title_Alfau_Citizen.label: Alfau Citizen
LanguageData.SEC_Title_Alfau_Citizen.description: Alfau citizens refer to intelligent beings who have obtained Alfau citizenship. They enjoy civil rights and also need to fulfill their civic obligations. Although Alfaus' colony ships may never come to this world, the local Secretary Nexus is still willing to grant citizenship to those who have lived and worked in secretaries' jurisdictions for a long time. By integrating them into the administrative system, the economy and society have been developed, the procedure integrity of democratic management has been maintained.
LanguageData.SEC_Title_Secretary_Service_Unit.label: Secretary Serving Unit
LanguageData.SEC_Title_Secretary_Service_Unit.descrip: The secretaries who have contacted the local Secretary Nexus will be marked as secretary serving unit. But it doesn't mean they can apply supports without limits, the resources in rimworld are limited, if the priority is not high enough and their contribution made to Secretary Nexus did not meet the performance standards, the local Secretary Nexus won't respond to their application.
